meta.title: Logan County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget (Ordinance 2026-01, passed December 15, 2025) as filed with the state. We used the 2026 appropriated amounts. Some funds move money into other county funds (transfer lines, $3,335,185.08 in all, most of it the 1/2 cent sales tax going to the jail fund), so those dollars appear in both funds.
